The '''Lipsec system''' was located in the [[Koradin sector/Legends|Koradin sector]], a part of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The [[Star system/Legends|system]] was situated at the endpoint of the [[Lipsec Run/Legends|Lipsec Run]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]], which connected it to the [[Virgillia system/Legends|Virgillia system]].<ref name="TEA" />

The area of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] surrounding the Lipsec system was [[Scout/Legends|explored]] between [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]] and [[25 BBY/Legends|25 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" /> During the early phase of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the [[Nineteenth Army|Nineteenth Sector Army]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] was charged with the defense of the system's vicinity against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

Shortly after the acquisition of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ukio/Legends|Ukio]] by the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]] during that conflict, the Lipsec system was featured on a [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Map/Legends|map]] displayed on a [[Viewscreen/Legends|viewscreen]] at a facility run by [[Passel Argente/Legends|Passel Argente]], the [[Magistrate/Legends|Magistrate]]<ref name="AoI">''[[The Clone Wars: Act on Instinct]]''</ref> of the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]].<ref name="DB Argente">{{DB|character|passelargente|Argente, Passel}}</ref> The population of the Lipsec system around [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]] numbered between one million and ten million.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Lipsec system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square I-18.<ref name="TEA" /> ''[[The Clone Wars: Act on Instinct]]'', a [[Star Wars comic books|webcomic]] authored by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and released on [[StarWars.com]]<ref name="AoI" /> over the span of the 2009<ref name="AoI announcement">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/news20091001comics/index.html|text=New ''Clone Wars'' Web Comic Tells Original Tale}}</ref>&ndash;[[2010]]<ref name="Lethal Trackdown Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode222.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Lethal Trackdown}}</ref> [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series,<ref name="AoI announcement" /> featured the first appearance of the system.<ref name="AoI" />
